name: Heather Carson Perkins
tagline: Top rated Civil Litigation attorney in Denver, Colorado
about: Heather Carson Perkins is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2016 - 2027. She works at Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP, located in Denver, Colorado, and provides legal services for issues involving Civil Litigation: Defense and Franchise / Dealership to the surrounding community.
Heather Perkins completed legal studies at University of Colorado Law School and graduated with the class of 1998. Heather Perkins passed the bar in 1998.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
